memberdef.name: save

briefdescription.para: Serializes and saves a graph to a file.

detaileddescription.para: Saves the graph topology and optionally its properties using the Graph Specification Format (GSF). The function strictly respects the write and append safety guards.

parameterdescription.para: The concrete type of the graph being saved. Must satisfy c_graph.
The save behavior tag (write or append). Defaults to write.
The graph instance to serialize.
The filesystem path where the graph will be saved. Defaults to "graph.gsf".
An initializer list of options_manip to configure the serialization (e.g., gl::io::with_properties).
If file safety checks fail (e.g., overwriting an existing file in write mode).
If the underlying file stream cannot be opened.

briefdescription.para: Deserializes and loads a graph from a file.

detaileddescription.para: Instantiates a new graph populated with the topology and properties read from the target GSF file.

parameterdescription.para: The target graph type to construct. Must match the directional nature of the saved graph.
The filesystem path from which to load the graph.

simplesect.para: A newly constructed graph populated with the file's data.

parameterdescription.para: If the file does not exist or is not a standard file.
If the file cannot be opened or if the GSF directional discriminator mismatches GraphType.

briefdescription.para: I/O stream operations, formatting, and serialization of graph data.

detaileddescription.para: This group provides the necessary infrastructure to seamlessly serialize, deserialize, and visualize complex graph structures. By offering a robust set of stream manipulators, range formatting utilities, and configuration options, it allows users to easily translate in-memory graphs to and from standard streams, files, or custom string representations.
